images.prompt:
Create a polished landscape 3:2 game environment concept painting for STARFALL: LANTERN LANDING, the exact 0% RESTORED state. This is the first frame of a five-state fixed-camera restoration sequence.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 is the approved WORLD MAP. Use only the miniature wooden lantern dock labeled 01 at its bottom left as the environment and art-direction reference. Enlarge and develop that one location. Do NOT copy its generic tiny star mascots, typography, villain, other islands or map numbers.
Image 2 is the authoritative ACTUAL STAR CAST. Preserve the crystalline silhouettes, colors, faceting, large blue/navy eyes and tiny expressive mouths of its six named characters. Use ONE of each, not the repeated expressions on the contact sheet. No arms, legs, clothes or humanoid bodies.

ART DIRECTION AND COMPOSITION:
A beautiful authored 3D storybook diorama with richly painted materials, soft volumetric lavender clouds, midnight blue cosmic sky, rounded nautical timber craftsmanship, restrained cream ceramic and aged brass. Charming premium family puzzle game, tactile and intimate, not photoreal and not a flat illustration.
Fixed three-quarter elevated camera, moderate orthographic perspective. Entire floating dock fully in frame with generous sky around it, no cropped objects. Dock fills lower two thirds of frame. Broad rosewood planks form an irregular rounded rectangular landing over lavender cloud banks; chunky rounded mooring posts and rope railings; a small bench back left; one neatly coiled mooring rope; a short gangway exits toward distant cloud at upper right. A short strand of three limp lavender pennants is attached between the mast and rear railing. Small inset star-shaped brass fittings on the dock are inanimate architectural details without faces.
One dominant tall wooden lantern mast rises at rear left, with a curved yardarm holding one generous oval cream-and-brass lantern above the gathering space. Keep its basic silhouette recognizably derived from map location 01. Design this single lantern with a clear lower glass wick chamber and a larger upper chamber of hinged cream ceramic petal shutters, held CLOSED at this stage. These shutters will open only at 100%. Show believable brass hinges. No other competing lanterns.
Frame must allow the mast to straighten later without any camera or layout change.

EXACT 0% ENVIRONMENT:
Murk has taken the ambient starlight. The lantern is completely UNLIT, lower wick cold, upper chamber closed and dark. The mast leans modestly, not collapsing. Dock planks are dull, slightly crooked and worn; ropes slack; pennants limp; brass fittings tarnished and unlit. It is quiet, faded and neglected, not dangerous or destroyed. Cool desaturated lavender-blue environmental light; NO warm pool or golden reflection from the lamp. Readable silhouettes, no pitch-black crush. Retain inviting potential. Still clearly nighttime.

THE ACTUAL CHARACTERS:
Place the six actual crystal stars hovering just above the front half of the dock in a loose little arrival group, well spaced with readable faces, about 8–11% of frame height each. They cast soft contact shadows and faint colored reflections on the wood. They are full crystalline star bodies with faces directly in the crystal, NEVER star-headed people.
Left-to-right: Spark (AQUA, tall vertically elongated FOUR-point crystal: top and bottom long, left and right short); Sunny (AMBER GOLD balanced FIVE-point crystal); Pip (MINT GREEN compact SIX-point crystal); Twinkle (ROSE PINK EIGHT alternating long/short pointed rays); Nova (PALE VIOLET wide horizontal FOUR-point crystal, sleepy eyelids); Dusk (DEEP PURPLE FIVE-point crystal, darker center and lilac luminous edges, mischievous brow, friendly companion).
Use exact reference point counts and silhouette distinctions. Do not turn all of them into generic five-point stars. Their own body colors remain vivid enough to identify even in the cold scene. Mildly concerned or curious expressions, no horror or crying. No extra characters or stars with faces in the background.

OUTPUT:
One full-bleed landscape concept frame, no text, no percentages, no border, no UI, no gameplay board, no title, no watermark. Exact same scene will be edited to later restoration states; prioritize clear landmark construction, consistent six-person cast and restrained readable staging.

The FINAL STRUCTURAL EVENT must be unmistakable: the upper cream ceramic lantern chamber has OPENED. Its same curved opaque panels now hinge outward and upward like a welcoming crown of four-to-six cream petal shutters, exposing a warm radiant golden light source inside.
